title: Debt MF bought Mar-2022 (before s.50AA), sold Oct-2024 after 31 months: long-term under the new 24-month rule, 12.5 % without indexation
rules: Income-tax Act 1961 s.50AA (inserted by Finance Act 2023) applies only to specified MF units acquired on or after 1-Apr-2023 -> not to this lot

Income-tax Act 1961 s.2(42A) as amended by Finance (No.2) Act 2024: for transfers on/after 23-Jul-2024 an asset other than a listed security is short-term if held not more than 24 months (was 36 months for debt MF units before)
Income-tax Act 1961 s.112(1) as amended by Finance (No.2) Act 2024: 12.5 % without indexation for transfers on/after 23-Jul-2024
Health and Education Cess 4 % (Finance (No.2) Act 2024 s.2)
derivation: Buy 2022-03-01: 1,000 units @ 20.00 -> cost 20,000.00 (acquired before 1-Apr-2023 -> s.50AA not applicable).
Held 2022-03-01 -> 2024-10-01 = 31 months. Transfer on/after 23-Jul-2024 -> threshold 24 months -> long (under the pre-23-Jul-2024 36-month rule it would have been short).
s.112 at 12.5 %, no indexation: tax 5,000 x 0.125 = 625.00; cess 25.00; total 650.00 for FY 2024-25 (fy 2025). exemption_used 0.00.
